svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="process-view-level-4-transports" name="process-view-level-4-transports"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor P as Participant (P1)
 participant S as Transport page (web app)
 participant H as Data and polling (web app)
 participant C as API client (web app)
 participant GW as API gateway
 participant CT as REST controller (Transports)
 participant J as Bus import job (Transports)
 participant UC as Use cases (Transports)
 participant TC as Porto Digital client (Transports)
 participant T as Porto Digital [FIWARE]
 participant DB as Transports DB
 loop Scheduled import, every 30 s
 J->>UC: Import bus positions
 UC->>TC: Fetch bus positions
 TC->>T: Request [HTTPS, timeout]
 alt Valid response
 T-->>TC: Bus positions
 TC-->>UC: Bus observations
 UC->>UC: Validate (required fields, times, routes)
 UC->>DB: One transaction (repositories): save bus observations and import time
 else Timeout, error or invalid data
 TC-->>UC: Error or invalid data
 UC->>DB: Keep last valid data, record failed import (repositories)
 end
 end
 P->>S: Opens the transport page
 S->>H: Start polling
 loop Every few seconds while the page is open
 H->>C: Get transport options and bus positions
 C->>GW: GET transport-options, bus-observations [HTTPS/JSON]
 GW->>CT: Validate JWT, forward
 CT->>UC: Get options and bus positions of this event
 UC->>DB: Read event shuttles, bus routes and latest bus observations (repositories)
 UC-->>CT: Options, bus positions, time of the data, stale flag
 CT-->>C: 200 OK
 C-->>H: Options and bus positions
 H-->>S: Updates the page
 alt Source available
 S-->>P: Shuttles and buses, \"Data from HH:MM\"
 else Source unavailable or data older than 5 min
 S-->>P: Last valid bus positions, \"Data from HH:MM\", warning, event shuttles still shown
 end
 end
 P->>S: Leaves the page
 S->>H: Stop polling
 Note over UC,T: The transport source is never called inside a user's request
",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
